title: Pulse counter
description: Pulses on one GPIO become revolutions per second; the running total is saved here.

keys.name: pulses_per_rev
keys.title: Pulses per revolution
keys.description: Pulses the sensor gives per revolution: teeth on the wheel, magnets on the shaft, poles of the alternator. Hz = pulses per second / this.

keys.name: period_ms
keys.title: Publish period
keys.description: How often the rate is computed and published. Longer is steadier at low pulse rates.

keys.name: total_pulses
keys.title: Pulse total
keys.description: Running total, written by the device at most once a minute. Set it to 0 to reset the counter.
